checks.description: The trial rebuilt as a TrialDesign (sites, visits, procedures from the paper; gaps filled with labelled assumptions) and run through the same engine the simulator uses, with the parameter library plus the trial's reported activity (e.g. coordinating-unit FTE). Tests the engine's model structure, not just its factors.

modules.explanation: Allocation difference. The engine puts one site-initiation round trip per site in set-up [carbon.site_initiation_trips.v1] plus a per-site documents factor; the paper books its initiation visits (UK rail, Australian flights) under meetings and travel and keeps only printing and postage (350 kg) in set-up.
modules.label: Trial set-up

modules.explanation: The engine applies one UK per-FTE factor (office energy + heating + commuting, 1,652.6 kg/FTE-year) to the paper's 1.8 FTE x 6 years. The paper computed the Australian coordinating unit's office electricity from a Victorian benchmark at 0.98 kg/kWh (7,347 kg for 0.5 FTE), about 13x the UK benchmark - most of the gap.
modules.label: Trial management (CTU emissions)

modules.explanation: Monitoring intensity. The paper reports monitoring as travel distance (UK 12,957 p.km by rail, Australia 15,310, Spain 3,280) but not the number of visits; the engine uses its default on-site frequency (FDA: 4-8-week intervals for major efficacy trials; mid 0.54 visits/site/month), i.e. several hundred visits over 6 years - far more than an academic phase 2 trial. The paper's audits (10.9 t of flights) have no engine equivalent. Reported activity applied: no investigator meeting.
modules.label: Meetings and travel

modules.explanation: Not comparable by design: the engine excludes the intervention module (manufacture out of scope, as in the method) and models drug kits in the drug_supply extension, which also includes manufacture. The paper's 1,252 kg here is IMP distribution and incineration of 1,464 overage bottles.
modules.label: Intervention (distribution only)

modules.explanation: The paper's CASPS used paper CRFs air-freighted to and from Australia and Spain (about 0.3 t); the engine's per-patient-year factor spans the two case studies and is applied over the 72-week visit window only.
modules.label: Data collection and exchange

modules.explanation: The paper's value is spend-based (GBP 1,350 of office machinery); the engine scales a per-patient factor, which fits neither trial well with 47 patients.
modules.label: Supplies and equipment

modules.explanation: The engine counts patient travel (km-based, per country) and per-procedure emissions (9 CT scans per patient, as reported). The paper also counts hospital utilities attributed to trial staff time (2,077 kg) and consumables (226 kg), which the engine does not model, and applies the UK 5.8 kg/visit travel factor to Australian and Spanish patients too.
modules.label: Patient assessments (incl. patient travel)

modules.explanation: Reported activity applied: 574 samples in 29 boxes, one third of one -80 C freezer. The engine's samples module also holds freezer storage (the paper books storage under laboratory), so samples and laboratory must be read together.

summary: CASPS: the paper's own arithmetic reproduces to +0.01% of the published 71,939 kg CO2e (71,943 kg); fixing the errors we documented moves it to 70,495 kg (-2.0%).

With TrialPilot's library factors the same activity data give 59,893 kg (P10-P90 57,818-62,709, -16.7% vs published), driven mostly by -80 C freezer storage (-5,048 kg); CTU office electricity (-2,882 kg). The full TrialPilot engine on the rebuilt design gives 88,758 kg (P10-P90 64,602-123,510, +23%), published total inside the range, with module-level differences explained per module.

trials.source: Griffiths J, Fox L, Williamson PR, on behalf of the Low Carbon Clinical Trials Group. Quantifying the carbon footprint of clinical trials: guidance development and case studies. BMJ Open 2024;14:e075755. doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2023-075755. Online supplemental appendix D (CC BY 4.0).
summary: PRIMETIME: the paper's own arithmetic reproduces to -0.16% of the published 89,360 kg CO2e (89,221 kg); fixing the errors we documented moves it to 89,221 kg (-0.2%).

With TrialPilot's library factors the same activity data give 86,971 kg (P10-P90 71,699-112,015, -2.7% vs published), driven mostly by Patient travel (-2,422 kg); Jiffy bags 243.8 kg (paper factor) (+74 kg). The full TrialPilot engine on the rebuilt design gives 109,686 kg (P10-P90 87,891-142,686, +23%), published total inside the range, with module-level differences explained per module.
trials.title: PRIMETIME: postoperative avoidance of radiotherapy (biomarker-selected very-low-risk breast cancer)
